10+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including at least 5 years in a senior IT leadership role

Prior Job Title or Occupational Experience:
Technology Management, CIO, CTO, VP or Director of Technology/Infrastructure

Prior Specific Functional Responsibilities:
Innovation, Entrepreneurship, Operations Leadership, IT Leadership, Digital Leadership, Infrastructure/Technology Operations Management, Service Desk/Desktop Support, IT Service Management (ITSM)

Preferred Experience:
Healthcare or hospital/ambulatory experience; Digital Leadership or IT Leadership; leading multi-site technology operations, service desk, and desktop support teams across a distributed facility footprint

Other Experience Requirements:
Proven leadership of successful transformation initiatives; deep experience managing enterprise infrastructure and disaster recovery programs, and partnering closely with cybersecurity/security leadership on secure technology operations; experience standing up or maturing an IT Service Management (ITSM) practice and associated tooling; understanding of core business and clinical processes and their associated technology solutions; strong written and verbal communication and executive presentation skills; change management; Lean or Six Sigma experience; vendor contract negotiation; and critical problem-solving and design

Knowledge/Skills

Understands the business and technical impact of emerging technologies and the issues involved in their adoption; no longer needs to be a hands-on practitioner.
Strong business acumen, customer experience, communication, and relationship-building skills.
Strategic and architectural thinker able to translate business and clinical objectives into actionable technology plans.
Strong architectural understanding of compute and compute hosting strategies, data center management, networking, service desk leadership, and desktop engineering and support.
Working knowledge of IT service management and governance frameworks (ITIL) and enterprise project management practices.
Sound understanding of cybersecurity risk and best practices; able to partner effectively with the Director, Information Security and Privacy (CISO) and other security, compliance, and risk leadership to ensure technology solutions are secure by design.
Working knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards and data exchange requirements (e.g., FHIR-based APIs, TEFCA) and their implications for enterprise architecture.
Understanding of responsible AI adoption and governance, including data quality, model oversight, and clinical safety considerations.
Strong functional understanding of the organization's core clinical and business applications and their interdependencies with the technology infrastructure and operations this role owns, most importantly the EHR, ERP, interface engine, and enterprise imaging solution.
Excellent executive presentation, written, and verbal communication skills; able to build consensus across clinical, business, and technology stakeholders.
Ability to lead and motivate distributed, cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, mission-driven healthcare environment.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Slack is looking for an Engineering Manager on the Core Services engineering team. The purpose of this role is to keep Slack working seamlessly at massive scale — it's the infrastructure that keeps Slack feeling lightning fast. This person will be a steward of some of the most critical, high-throughput systems at Slack — the kind of work where doing it well means millions of users, at the world’s most important and interesting companies, never experience a hiccup.

About The Opportunity

We operate at tremendous scale with systems that process millions of events per second. Our team maintains and builds performant services that include:

Edge Caches
Realtime Services
Enterprise Key Management (EKM)
International Data Residency (IDR)
Image Uploads, Downloads, and Proxying

We've done our job correctly when none of our users think about us, much like a vital utility. We don't typically ship new user-facing features, but rather ensure our systems are exceptionally performant, highly available, reliable, and scalable. In other words, we make Slack work seamlessly. Slack's backend services are written in Go and Java, and Slack's API is built on PHP/Hack.

The Core Services Team

We are a team building critical services that enable Slack to scale for our largest customers. Our edge caches power the most latency-critical queries for our largest entities today, serving approximately 35% of all Slack API traffic. Our Realtime Services (RTS) power Slack's core messaging stack — running 10 services, 4 of which are mission-critical Tier 0 services — ensuring that messages, presence, and real-time events are delivered reliably at scale. We also own services that power Slack's Enterprise Key Management and International Data Residency features, enabling Slack to win and retain enterprise and government customers with strict compliance requirements (FedRAMP/NIST).

We have a strong commitment to quality and understand that simplicity and reliability are the foundations of our work.

We are actively building the future of edge services at Slack, so we can support a growing number of globally distributed customers with their compliance requirements with minimal latency.

What You'll Be Doing:

Owning the technical direction and roadmap across the Core Services portfolio: Edge Caches, Realtime Services, Enterprise Key Management, International Data Residency, and Image Proxying and Uploads. You’ll have large footprint and the opportunity to drive major impact. And you'll decide what to invest in now, what to sequence later, and what to decline — balancing reliability, migration, and new capability work.
Leading a multi-system migration of Flannel to Loom, our next-generation edge cache, while keeping the current systems running at full reliability for millions of users. You'll drive the team to ship new capabilities without introducing risk to infrastructure that people depend on daily.
Driving delivery and execution while maintaining reliability as a top priority, including sprint planning, product launches, incident follow-ups, operational sustainability analyses, and building the technical case for investment with leadership. You'll ensure the team doesn't trade reliability for velocity, but is always high-performing.
Owning on-call operations and incident management for Tier 0 services. You'll manage on-call rotations across partnering teams, triage production issues, lead incident response for your services, and drive improvements to runbooks, alerting, and operational tooling.
Partnering cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Compliance, Security, AWS, and other infrastructure teams on dependencies, timelines, and risks. You'll be the shortest path to solutions — whether it's unblocking a compliance audit for South Korea, coordinating IDR region launches with Sales and AWS, or negotiating priorities with partner teams for shared work.
Representing your team's work in leadership reviews, quarterly and annual planning, and executive forums. You'll build compelling business-and-technical cases for your team's investments and tell your leadership what's really going on early enough that nothing becomes a fire drill.
Building and maintaining a high-trust team culture where engineers do impactful work and grow. You'll hire well, manage performance with fairness and transparency, mentor emerging technical leaders, and celebrate your team's wins.
Managing cost and capacity for services that run at massive scale, working with finance on AWS spend trends, exec-approved budget increases, and cost-saving initiatives like the Loom migration (projected $1-2M savings).
Driving the team to adopt AI development tooling for maximum impact, while maintaining engineering rigor and quality for critical infrastructure.

You're Our Person If:

You've led engineering teams for 5+ years building and operating high-scale, high-availability backend infrastructure or distributed systems.
You have strong software engineering fundamentals with previous experience as a Senior+ backend engineer, with enough depth to be credible in architecture discussions about caching, distributed systems, observability and reliability best practices, and system design — and to build SME knowledge in a new area fast.
You have a history of managing Tier 0 / Tier 1 services where uptime matters deeply, including owning on-call rotations, leading incident response, and driving operational improvements.
You have experience with realtime messaging systems or event-driven architectures at scale — presence, message delivery, pub/sub, or similar systems where latency and reliability directly impact user experience.
You have experience leading multi-quarter migration or platform evolution projects while simultaneously keeping existing systems reliable.
You've managed teams through prioritization trade-offs — weighing reliability vs. feature work vs. cost vs. compliance — and can articulate those decisions to both engineers and executives.
You have experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Sales, Compliance, Security, Infrastructure) to turn business requirements into engineering plans.
You understand how to build a high-performing team culture: hiring, performance management, retention of top performers, and growing new technical leaders.
You have experience managing engineers across multiple time zones, with an async rhythm that doesn't depend on overlap hours.
An understanding of how and where AI software development tooling can be deployed for maximum team impact.

Even Better If:

You have experience with the Go and/or Java programming language at scale.
Experience with AWS infrastructure, including multi-region architectures.
Experience with Kubernetes and container-based deployments.
Experience working within highly regulated environments where an understanding of FedRAMP/NIST frameworks was essential.
Experience with Enterprise Key Management, data residency, or compliance-driven infrastructure.
You've managed teams responsible for Edge Caching, CDN, or API gateway systems.
You've led teams through system deprecation and migration while maintaining service reliability.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

jobs.title: Senior Service Systems, Infrastructure and Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
Repligen is seeking a Senior Service Systems, Infrastructure & Analytics Manager to lead the systems, data infrastructure, integrations, and analytics that support our rapidly growing global service organization. Reporting to the VP, Service, this role sits at the intersection of technology, data, and service operations, partnering across Service, IT, Commercial Operations, Finance, Quality, and Field Service to build scalable solutions that drive business performance, operational excellence, and customer success.

This role is expected to model our Leadership Behaviors—Integrity & Compliance, Customer Focus, Collaboration, Courage, Team Empowerment, and Accountability & Results—in all aspects of work.

Responsibilities

Partner with service leadership to define, document, and continuously improve global service business processes, standards, and best practices.
Translate business needs and user experiences into clear system requirements and scalable technical solutions that support the long-term growth of the service business.
Lead the design, configuration, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of service business systems and infrastructure on a global scale.
Design, manage, and enhance integrations between Salesforce, SAP, internally developed service applications, reporting platforms, and other business systems.
Develop and execute a service master data strategy, ensuring data integrity, governance, consistency, and accessibility across systems.
Build, maintain, and continuously improve dashboards, reports, and KPI frameworks that enable data-driven decision making and provide leaders with clear visibility into business performance.
Develop reporting and visualization solutions using Power BI, Tableau, and related analytics tools to deliver meaningful operational and strategic insights.
Create and manage data flows, queries, automations, and reporting structures that transform data from multiple sources into actionable business intelligence.
Act as a trusted partner to Service, IT, Commercial Operations, Finance, Quality, and Field Service teams, building strong relationships and aligning stakeholders around shared business objectives.
Provide technical guidance and business context to IT and development teams, helping prioritize enhancements, solve complex challenges, and identify opportunities for innovation.
Promote consistency and operational excellence by driving adoption of global processes, systems, and reporting methodologies across the organization.
Develop training materials, user documentation, and support programs that empower users and enable successful adoption of systems and tools.
Evaluate emerging technologies and analytics capabilities, proactively identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, visibility, and the overall customer experience.
Take ownership of strategic initiatives from concept through implementation, driving measurable outcomes through collaboration, influence, and continuous improvement.
Help shape the future of the Service Systems, Infrastructure & Analytics function by contributing to team development, process maturity, and long-term organizational success.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
7+ years of experience in business systems, analytics, systems architecture, service operations technology, or related disciplines.
Experience supporting field service, technical service, customer support, or equipment-based service organizations.
Strong experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, SAP, Power BI, Tableau, and related business systems.
Proven experience designing system integrations, APIs, data flows, reporting frameworks, and business process automation.
Experience developing dashboards, KPIs, and analytics solutions that support operational and strategic decision-making.
Strong understanding of data architecture, master data management, data governance, and data quality best practices.
Working knowledge of SQL, Python, Power Query, DAX, Power Automate, C#, HTML, or similar scripting and automation tools.
Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and measurable business outcomes.
Proven success leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders across Service, IT, Commercial Operations, Finance, and Quality organizations.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with a customer-focused mindset and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Our mission is to inspire advances in bioprocessing as a trusted partner in the production of biologic drugs that improve human health worldwide. Focused on cost and process efficiencies, we deliver innovative technologies and solutions that help set new standards in bioprocessing. The estimated base salary range for this role, based in the United States of America is $134,000-$192,000. Compensation decisions are dependent on several factors including, but not limited to an individual's ,qualifications, location, internal equity, and alignment with market data. Additionally, employees are eligible to participate in one of our variable cash programs (bonus or commission) and eligible roles may receive equity as part of the compensation package. We offer a wide range of benefits such as paid time off, health/dental/vision, retirement benefits and flexible spending accounts. jobs.title: Senior Service Systems, Infrastructure and Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
Repligen is seeking a Senior Service Systems, Infrastructure & Analytics Manager to lead the systems, data infrastructure, integrations, and analytics that support our rapidly growing global service organization. Reporting to the VP, Service, this role sits at the intersection of technology, data, and service operations, partnering across Service, IT, Commercial Operations, Finance, Quality, and Field Service to build scalable solutions that drive business performance, operational excellence, and customer success.

This role is expected to model our Leadership Behaviors—Integrity & Compliance, Customer Focus, Collaboration, Courage, Team Empowerment, and Accountability & Results—in all aspects of work.

Responsibilities

Partner with service leadership to define, document, and continuously improve global service business processes, standards, and best practices.
Translate business needs and user experiences into clear system requirements and scalable technical solutions that support the long-term growth of the service business.
Lead the design, configuration, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of service business systems and infrastructure on a global scale.
Design, manage, and enhance integrations between Salesforce, SAP, internally developed service applications, reporting platforms, and other business systems.
Develop and execute a service master data strategy, ensuring data integrity, governance, consistency, and accessibility across systems.
Build, maintain, and continuously improve dashboards, reports, and KPI frameworks that enable data-driven decision making and provide leaders with clear visibility into business performance.
Develop reporting and visualization solutions using Power BI, Tableau, and related analytics tools to deliver meaningful operational and strategic insights.
Create and manage data flows, queries, automations, and reporting structures that transform data from multiple sources into actionable business intelligence.
Act as a trusted partner to Service, IT, Commercial Operations, Finance, Quality, and Field Service teams, building strong relationships and aligning stakeholders around shared business objectives.
Provide technical guidance and business context to IT and development teams, helping prioritize enhancements, solve complex challenges, and identify opportunities for innovation.
Promote consistency and operational excellence by driving adoption of global processes, systems, and reporting methodologies across the organization.
Develop training materials, user documentation, and support programs that empower users and enable successful adoption of systems and tools.
Evaluate emerging technologies and analytics capabilities, proactively identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, visibility, and the overall customer experience.
Take ownership of strategic initiatives from concept through implementation, driving measurable outcomes through collaboration, influence, and continuous improvement.
Help shape the future of the Service Systems, Infrastructure & Analytics function by contributing to team development, process maturity, and long-term organizational success.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
7+ years of experience in business systems, analytics, systems architecture, service operations technology, or related disciplines.
Experience supporting field service, technical service, customer support, or equipment-based service organizations.
Strong experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, SAP, Power BI, Tableau, and related business systems.
Proven experience designing system integrations, APIs, data flows, reporting frameworks, and business process automation.
Experience developing dashboards, KPIs, and analytics solutions that support operational and strategic decision-making.
Strong understanding of data architecture, master data management, data governance, and data quality best practices.
Working knowledge of SQL, Python, Power Query, DAX, Power Automate, C#, HTML, or similar scripting and automation tools.
Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and measurable business outcomes.
Proven success leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders across Service, IT, Commercial Operations, Finance, and Quality organizations.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with a customer-focused mindset and a commitment to continuous improvement.

What Repligen Offers

Our mission is to inspire advances in bioprocessing as a trusted partner in the production of biologic drugs that improve human health worldwide. jobs.title: Director, Office of Science and Engineering Laboratories (OSEL)
jobs.description:
Duties

Summary

This position is being filled under a stream-lined hiring authority, Title 21 of the United States Code (21 US Code 379d-3a) as amended by the 21st Century Cures Act of 2016, section 3072 and the Consolidated Appropriations Act of 2023, Section 3624. The candidate selected for this position will serve under a career or career-conditional appointment and be paid under the provisions of this authority. This position is being recruited based on the Title 21 Pay Table 4, Band G.

Requirements

Qualifications

In order to qualify for the Director, Office of Science and Engineering Laboratories (OSEL) position which falls under the 1301 occupational Series, you must meet the following requirements by 11:59 pm EST on 10/28/2026: The candidate must meet the following qualifications for this Title 21 position: Scientific, Technical, and/or Professional Fields Qualified and Outstanding Candidates a. Qualified applies to all candidates for Cures appointments. The FDA OTS will use the technical qualifications defined below as a baseline for comparing experience levels and other candidate attributes for relevant positions b, Outstanding candidates can be defined by existing outstanding work experience, outstanding performance rating, or both. Minimum Qualifications: To qualify for a Band G Director, Office of Science and Engineering Laboratories (OSEL) position, you must meet the Education Requirement listed in the Education section below. Desired Qualifications: Possesses a Ph.D. in the life sciences or an M.D./Ph.D. degree, with advanced research and scientific training relevant to the position. The preferred qualification reflects the depth of research expertise needed to lead multidisciplinary regulatory science programs and address complex scientific and emerging technologies. An M.D. without a Ph.D. is not considered equivalent to the preferred research and scientific background. This position is designated as an SES Equivalent position and is covered under the FDA Title 21 Executive Performance Management System and identified as a public filing position for ethics purposes. While PHS Commissioned Corps Officers cannot hold a Title 21 position during their active service as PHS Officers, we welcome and encourage them to apply-their applications will receive full consideration. Please note that if selected, the Officer will need to end their Commissioned Corps appointment before being placed in the Title 21 position. NOTE: Applicants must submit all relevant transcripts that demonstrate you possess the required education to meet the Basic Qualifications. Supervisory Responsibilities The incumbent is delegated full authority to achieve group goals and objectives through the effective management of available resources. Performance and accomplishments are assessed primarily through work performance indicators, staff discussion, planning sessions, review of individual project outputs, and annual program review. Leads in a proactive, customer-responsive manner consistent with Agency vision and values, effectively communicating program issues to external audiences. Ensures financial and managerial accountability by acting with prudence when executing fiduciary responsibilities. Demonstrates high integrity and adheres to the highest ethical standards of public service. Uses effective business practices including balanced measures of results, values, and invests in each employee; emphasizes empowerment and two-way communication. Takes a leadership role in advocating for and advancing the priorities of the Agency. Serves as a role model for leadership by encouraging teamwork and a collaborative approach. Timely notifies Agency officials of all significant actions and developments, including but not limited to those related to regulatory matters, legislative matters, budget matters, reports, initiatives, and events and ensures subordinate managers do the same. Provides reasonable accommodations needed to best utilize qualified people with disabilities. Organizational Management: Manages the Office of Science and Engineering Laboratories (OSEL) within CDRH to sustain and advance a preeminent regulatory science enterprise capable of addressing frontier scientific challenges at the forefront of medical device regulation. Establishes strategic direction and priorities across OSEL's scientific programs spanning life sciences, biological sciences, engineering, physical sciences, and computational sciences. Ensures alignment of OSEL's organizational objectives with CDRH and FDA-wide priorities and regulatory mission. Program Management: Runs a multidisciplinary regulatory science program in the Center encompassing multiple laboratories and scientific disciplines. Directs and evaluates activities addressing scientific and technical questions relevant to medical devices and radiation-emitting products, including test methods, biocompatibility, biological testing, in vitro/in vivo evaluation, computational modeling, and reference materials. Establishes new scientific programs and frameworks in areas without precedent, shaping how emerging and complex technologies are evaluated across the regulatory enterprise. Oversees a highly diverse workforce across scientific, professional, technical, and administrative occupational series. Resource Management: Monitors and reports on resources needed to lead strategic resource planning for OSEL and its multidisciplinary regulatory science programs. Establishes annual and multi-year objectives, determines program priorities, and allocates resources across OSEL's scientific programs. Evaluates the effectiveness and regulatory impact of OSEL programs to inform resource planning and ensure efficient use of available resources in support of CDRH's regulatory mission. Human Capital Management: Identifies employee competencies necessary to meet OSEL's organizational capabilities goals across its multidisciplinary scientific workforce. Designs competency frameworks and workforce architecture to ensure OSEL maintains the scientific capabilities needed for current and emerging regulatory science challenges. Promotes employee development and identifies workforce and succession needs to ensure OSEL maintains the scientific knowledge, methods, tools, and capabilities required to address current and emerging regulatory challenges. Provides leadership to subordinate managers and supervisors and ensures effective and equitable management of the organization.

Become a part of the Department that touches the lives of every American. At the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) you can give back to your community, state, and country, by making a difference in the lives of Americans everywhere! HHS is the principal agency for protecting the health of citizens. Join HHS and help to make our world healthier, safer, and better for all Americans. The Food and Drug Administration is the regulatory, scientific, public health, and consumer protection agency responsible for ensuring that all human and animal drugs, and medical devices are safe and effective, that cosmetics, foods, food additives, drugs and medicated feeds for food producing animals, and radiation emitting devices are safe, and that all such products marketed in the United States are adequately, truthfully and informatively labeled and safely and properly stored, transported, manufactured packaged and regulated. The position is located in the Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS), Food and Drug Administration (FDA), Center for Devices and Radiological Health (CDRH), Office of Science and Engineering Laboratories (OSEL). The mission of the Center for Devices and Radiological Health (CDRH) is to protect and promote public health. CDRH assures that patients and providers have timely and continued access to safe, effective, and high-quality medical devices and safe radiation-emitting products.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
JLL Technologies is a specialized group within JLL. At JLL Technologies, our mission is to bring technological innovation to commercial real estate. We deliver unparalleled digital advisory, implementation, and services solutions to organizations globally. Our goal is to leverage technology to increase the value and liquidity of the world’s buildings, while enhancing the productivity and happiness of those that occupy them.

The Data Engineering team builds and operates the data products and pipelines that power JLL’s Corporate Functions, including areas such as finance, HR, Legal, Compliance and shared services. Working on the Enterprise Data Platform (EDP), we turn internal enterprise data into trusted, governed, and increasingly real-time assets that leaders and teams across the firm rely on for reporting, planning, and operational decisions.

What this job involves

As Senior Data Engineering Manager, you will lead multiple related scrum teams of data engineers responsible for Corporate Functions data – from ingestion and streaming pipelines through curated, governed data products. Your teams own the reliability, quality, and timeliness of the data that underpins enterprise reporting, financial and workforce analytics, and shared-services operations.

You will own delivery and direction for the Corporate Functions data engineering function: setting priorities across teams, allocating resources, guiding technical design, and partnering with product, analytics, and business leaders to translate needs into a clear roadmap. You will be accountable for team outcomes, data quality standards, and the continuous improvement of engineering practices.

The ideal candidate blends the technical credibility of a Lead Data Engineer – hands-on depth in Python, Azure, and streaming architectures – with proven people leadership, and the ability to build trust with senior business stakeholders.

What you’ll get to do

As Senior Data Engineering Manager, your “customers” include leaders and teams in Finance, HR, Legal, Compliance and other Corporate Functions, data analysts and BI teams, product managers, and fellow platform and governance teams across JLL Technologies. Your mission is to lead the Corporate Functions data engineering function – defining the roadmap, operating model, and quality standards that make data trusted, timely, and reusable.

This is an opportunity to shape how streaming and governed data enable faster, better-informed decisions across the enterprise – and to grow a high-performing engineering organization while doing it.

Key responsibilities

Technical Leadership:
Provide hands-on technical direction for batch and streaming data pipelines built on Azure, Python, and Spark. Guide architecture and design reviews, set engineering standards for reusable frameworks, and stay close to critical technical risks.

Real-Time and Streaming Data Delivery:
Lead the design and operation of event-driven pipelines using technologies such as Kafka and Spark Streaming, so that financial, workforce, and operational data reaches downstream consumers with the latency and reliability the business requires.

Data Governance and Quality:
Own data quality, lineage, cataloging, and stewardship practices for Corporate Functions data domains, including sensitive finance and HR data. Define measurable quality standards, automate validation and monitoring in pipelines, and partner with enterprise governance and security teams to ensure compliance with JLL data policies and access controls.

Delivery Management:
Set priorities and manage execution across multiple scrum teams. Balance roadmap commitments, technical debt, and operational demands; maintain predictable delivery; and adapt plans as business needs evolve.

Platform Alignment and Modernization:
Align team deliverables with the Enterprise Data Platform strategy. Drive adoption of platform standards, ingestion patterns, and cloud-native services, and contribute to modernization of legacy data assets.

Reliability and Operational Excellence:
Establish CI/CD, observability, and incident management practices that keep pipelines healthy. Ensure teams meet service-level expectations and learn from production issues through blameless reviews.

Cross-Functional Leadership:
Collaborate with product, analytics, data science, platform, security, and governance teams to deliver end-to-end data solutions. Resolve dependencies, negotiate shared priorities, and keep teams aligned on outcomes.

Team Development and Mentorship:
Recruit, coach, and retain strong engineers and team leads. Set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, build career growth paths, and foster a culture of inclusion, ownership, and continuous learning.

Stakeholder Management:
Build trusted relationships with Corporate Functions business and technology leaders. Communicate status, risks, and trade-offs clearly, manage expectations on scope and timelines, and ensure engineering work maps to business value.

Resource and Budget Planning:
Partner with leadership on headcount, vendor, and cloud cost planning for your teams, optimizing talent utilization and cost efficiency across products and initiatives.

Who you are

You are a people-first engineering leader who has grown from strong hands-on data engineering roots. You earn credibility with engineers by understanding the technical detail – from distributed processing to data modeling trade-offs – while inspiring them through clear direction, coaching, and high standards. You navigate competing priorities with composure, explain complex topics plainly to executives, and hold yourself accountable for both team outcomes and the quality of the data your teams deliver. You are energized by turning ambiguous business needs into reliable, governed data products.

Required Qualifications

People management: 2+ years directly managing data engineers or technical individual contributors; experience setting priorities, allocating work, and coaching teams; managing managers is not required.
Data engineering experience: 7+ years in data engineering, including multiple large and complex projects delivered end to end.
Technical depth: Advanced Python and SQL; strong experience with Azure data services and distributed processing (e.g., Spark/PySpark); experience building reusable frameworks.
Streaming: Hands-on experience designing or leading real-time data pipelines with Kafka, Spark Streaming, or equivalent technologies.
Data governance and quality: Working knowledge of data quality frameworks, lineage, metadata management, and data governance practices.
Delivery: Experience managing or training teams of data engineers and setting priorities across multiple data engineering workstreams in an agile environment.
Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Experience with corporate data domains such as finance, HR, or shared services (e.g., ERP, HRIS, or enterprise reporting data), or in commercial real estate.
Experience with NoSQL, graph, or multi-model databases (e.g., CosmosDB, MongoDB) and complex cross-system integrations.
Familiarity with data cataloging and governance tooling, and with CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code practices.
Experience with modern lakehouse or data platform architectures and enterprise data platforms.
Exposure to applying AI/ML or LLM-based capabilities to data engineering and data quality workflows.

Key attributes

Leadership:
Builds and retains strong teams; delegates effectively while staying close to critical technical risks.

Job Description

At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we are building the next generation of cloud services that power mission-critical workloads for customers around the world. OCI combines the speed, ownership, and innovation of a startup with the scale, reliability, and customer focus of one of the world’s leading technology companies.

Oracle Managed Kubernetes (OMK) is Oracle Cloud Infrastructure's (OCI) enterprise-grade Kubernetes service that provides a managed, scalable, and secure environment to deploy containerized applications. It is built on the open-source Kubernetes engine and designed to simplify operations, improve performance, and provide deep integration with the broader OCI ecosystem.

We are seeking an experienced hands-on senior engineering manager to manage and grow a team of highly talented engineers responsible for designing, building, and operating software systems for OMK. You will own delivery, architecture, reliability, and operational health across multiple software areas while developing strong engineering leaders and technical talent.

The ideal candidate is an experienced engineering leader with a strong background in distributed systems, cloud services, operational platforms, and people leadership. You are comfortable operating in ambiguous, high-scale environments, driving technical strategy, building durable teams, and partnering across engineering, product, operations, and infrastructure organizations to deliver measurable business impact.

This is an opportunity to lead teams building software that directly improves how OCI supports global data center infrastructure, reduces operational friction, increases automation, and enables OCI to scale efficiently.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development:

Lead multiple platform teams to standardize middleware patterns and client libraries used by several consumer teams.
Establish group-level guardrails for APIs/SDKs, deprecation strategies, and upgrade playbooks; track adoption and risk.
Sponsor shared observability frameworks and capacity models across teams; review error-budget posture and corrective actions.

Manages the execution of processes to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and to develop documents to clarify software design and code.

Utilizes an analytic approach to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding.
Leads teams in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.
Leads teams to implement API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:

Collaborates with stakeholders and external clients and/or partners to understand customer issues and align solutions.
Leads team(s) to provide technical guidance and appropriately prioritize support to customers regarding reported issues.
Acts as a role model for teams to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.
Develops, modifies, and executes policies to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.
Leads teams through processes for handling customer issues and/or defects handling and directs them to training opportunities as needed.
Manages the investigation and troubleshooting of complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions.

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:

Collaborates with teams and other stakeholders within and outside of group to establish, follow, and enforce documented security criteria, development industry best practices and processes, and coding standards.
Ensures clarity of teams' operational objectives for adherence to broad acceptance criteria.
Implements moderately complex secure software development practices requiring information gathering and analysis to prevent security vulnerabilities.

Development Operations - System Maintenance:

Leads teams in performing periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).
Delegates assignments to teams to implement and evolve standard operating procedures (SOP) for development and for driving improvements, ensuring automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

Manages multiple medium- to large-scale projects or initiatives across teams, ensuring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable are monitored and met. Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs. Guides teams on adjusting plans to accommodate resource or timeline changes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

Drives cross-functional partnerships to align expectations and shared objectives across multiple teams. Coaches team members to develop strategic relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and external partners to foster collaboration and long-term success. Promotes inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

Problem Solving:

Provides direction to multiple teams on addressing complex operational and/or technical issues as well as providing guidance on analyzing complex data and/or information to identify solutions. Reviews and provides insights into unresolved or critical issues, helping the team to identify potential solutions.

Continuous Learning:

Models engaging in continuous learning to deepen expertise and stay ahead of industry trends, integrating best practices into strategic planning. Leverages feedback to drive personal and team skill improvements. Identifies skill gaps across teams, and empowers team members to pursue learning and knowledge sharing opportunities that build their expertise in new areas and coaches them to apply learnings to advance the organization.

Continuous Improvement:

Drives team to collaborate on, develop, and implement ideas to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within and across teams, providing oversight. Guides team to adopt new ideas for alternative approaches and methods and encourages feedback for continued improvement.

Performance and Development:

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Digital Experience
jobs.description:
Job Description

About the Role

Our Digital Experience engineering organization is growing from 16 to more than 21 engineers across multiple squads — including three squads working in a shared codebase — while delivering the most consequential initiatives on our roadmap. We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead this organization through its next stage of growth: its strategy, its processes, its people, and its partnership with Product.
You'll lead through a layer of squad leads who own the day-to-day and performance of their squads (engineers and QA). Your job is to manage, coach, and develop those leads, inspect team-level outcomes, and own the health of the engineering organization as a whole.
The measure of this role is not individual output. It is whether the teams around you deliver faster, more predictably, and with fewer things in their way.
What You'll Own

Engineering Strategy
Be the engineering voice in strategic conversations about what we build and how we build it — participating from the first conversation on new initiatives, not after decisions are made.
Shape how the engineering organization is structured — squad composition, roles, and skill mix — to meet current-year objectives while planning for a multi-year horizon.
Own the point of view on our tech stack and architecture direction: whether what we have today supports where the product is going, and what needs to change before it becomes a constraint.
Partner with Product leadership as a peer when planning future years — Product brings the business perspective, you bring the engineering perspective, and together you organize the squads and the plans.

Engineering Leadership — Process and Tone
Set the process and tone for how engineering runs — the "how" (development and release processes) and the "what" (team functions and responsibilities) — without removing squad independence.
Establish and steward a release process appropriate for an organization of this size: who does what and why, checklists, rollback plans, and cross-team notification.
Define the development process end to end: how PRs move through the system, what the delivery pipeline looks like, how AI is incorporated into engineering work, and what happens when problems arise.
Be the leader engineers look to for expectations. When something isn't clear, work with the leads to make it clear.
Provide stewardship for the squads sharing a codebase as the organization grows — alignment on standards, coordination, and shared ownership.
Bring a clear point of view to Product leadership on what Product should bring to the table for engineering teams to work effectively — and expect the same in return.

Leadership Development & Organizational Health
Manage, coach, and develop the squad leads — your direct reports and the primary lever for everything else.
Build a consistent management practice across squads: how leads run their teams, coach their people, handle performance, and grow their engineers — so an engineer's experience doesn't depend on which squad they're on.
Maintain an accurate talent picture across the organization through the leads: who is growing, who needs support, who is ready for more complex work, and whether people are progressing at the pace we'd expect.
Own engineering throughput at the organizational level: how stories move through development, where they get stuck, and what to change. Find bottlenecks and work with leads to fix them.
Plan capacity and hiring ahead of need as the team scales, so process and staffing don't become the reasons delivery slows down.

Thought Partnership
Come to the table with thinking not just on how tasks get completed, but on how we organize and enable teams to complete them. Removing what's in the teams' way matters more than doing the work yourself.
Be a genuine peer to Product and business leadership — someone who strengthens strategic conversations rather than just executing their outcomes.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days:
A clear diagnosis of current delivery bottlenecks with a recommended plan, and established expectations with leads on how teams run.
First year:
Release and development processes that scale to 21+ engineers; throughput measurably improved; a lead layer that is managing well and consistently; a talent picture leadership trusts; engineering fully represented in next-year planning.
Ongoing:
Product and engineering leadership operating like sections of the same orchestra — aligned on expectations in both directions, planning the future together.

Responsibilities and Benefits

What We're Looking For

Experience leading engineering organizations of 15–40 people through a growth phase, ideally with multiple squads in a shared codebase.
Experience managing through a leadership layer — developing leads rather than managing every engineer directly.
A track record of building right-sized process — enough structure to scale, not so much that squads lose independence.
Strong people-management instincts: coaching, performance development, and the judgment to make talent recommendations backed by direct inspection.
Fluency with delivery metrics and workflow data; comfort diagnosing bottlenecks and acting on them.
Strategic range: able to contribute to multi-year product and organizational planning, not just current-quarter execution.
A collaborative operating style with Product — a peer partner, not a service provider.

How You're Supported
As part of the Mission Pet Health family, you get the stability of a local practice backed by the comprehensive benefits and resources of a larger network. The focus is on investing in you, so you can focus on what you love.

Note: Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support you at every stage. Eligibility for specific benefits varies based on your role and hours worked.
Competitive Compensation

A competitive hourly rate or salary based on your experience and role.
Health & Wellbeing

We offer comprehensive coverage options including Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance, along with access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for all teammates.
Financial Security

Plan for your future with our 401k retirement options and additional financial protection benefits like Life Insurance and Disability coverage.
Commitment to Growth

We support your career goals with opportunities for professional development, including educational assistance for qualified teammates to enroll in AVMA-accredited veterinary technician programs.
The Power of a Network

Join a nationwide community of over 20,000 veterinary professionals who share a passion for collaboration, career growth, and sharing best practices.
Valuable Perks

Enjoy discounted veterinary care for your own pets, access to an online discount platform, and free 24/7 access to doctors through Teladoc.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Blackstone Law is growing fast. With nearly 50 attorneys, we’ve become one of California’s leading plaintiff side employment law firms, representing employees in individual and class action employment matters.

We’ve built a fast-moving, technology driven firm that combines experienced legal judgment with technology and automation to work smarter and deliver better outcomes for our clients. We’re looking for talented CTO Professional who are excited about the opportunity to help us grow our presence in a new market.

Our culture is collaborative, comfortable, and performance driven. We work hard, support one another, and believe you can do exceptional work while still having a life outside of it. We’re a family that values each person’s contribution and invests in their growth.

About the Role

Blackstone Law is looking for a forward-thinking, hands-on Chief Technology Officer to lead the next phase of our technology strategy.

We have already made significant investments in technology, AI, automation, and data. We’re looking for an experienced technology leader who will take us to the next level.

This is not a traditional IT leadership role. We need someone who understands how AI, data, software, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and automation work together—and can translate those capabilities into measurable improvements in how a modern law firm operates.

The CTO will partner directly with executive leadership while providing technical direction and accountability to our internal and external technology resources.

While we are primarily seeking a full-time CTO, we are open to considering the right candidate on a fractional basis initially.

What You’ll Do

Own and execute the firm’s technology, AI, data, and infrastructure strategy.

Assess our current technology environment, architecture, systems, integrations, vendors, and development initiatives and identify gaps, risks, and opportunities.

Lead the firm’s AI strategy, including the evaluation, development, implementation, and governance of AI-powered tools and workflows.

Provide technical leadership and accountability for developers, IT resources, consultants, and technology vendors.

Establish clear expectations around project scope, milestones, deliverables, timelines, and performance.

Identify opportunities to automate workflows, improve productivity, strengthen knowledge management, and better leverage firm data.

Ensure our technology environment is secure, scalable, reliable, and positioned to support continued growth.

Oversee cybersecurity, data governance, privacy, business continuity, disaster recovery, and technology risk.

Evaluate emerging technologies based on practical business value—not technology for technology’s sake.

Partner with the Leadership, attorneys, and operational leaders to translate business needs into practical technology solutions.

Own technology budgeting and help leadership make informed investment decisions.

What We’re Looking For

10+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including CTO, CIO, VP/Head of Technology, or comparable leadership experience.

Proven experience building and executing technology strategies within a growing organization.

Strong technical knowledge across AI, data architecture, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, systems integration, and software development.

Hands-on experience evaluating, implementing, and scaling AI and automation solutions.

Experience leading developers, engineers, IT professionals, vendors, and outsourced technology resources.

Ability to quickly assess an existing technology environment and determine what should be scaled, improved, replaced, or rebuilt.

Strong execution and project-management discipline with a track record of turning strategy into measurable results.

Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical executives and business leaders.

Experience working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial organization.

Law firm or legal technology experience preferred; professional services experience is also highly valued.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering & Development
jobs.description:
Overview

SitelogIQ
is a world-class team making a large-scale impact on the efficiency and sustainability of the places we live, work, shop, and heal.

SitelogIQ delivers turnkey solutions across energy efficiency: lighting upgrades
, EV infrastructure
, solar and energy storage system
[distributed generation (DG)] , and other facility improvement measures (FIMs)
that transform built environments and breathe life into the sustainability, financial, and resiliency goals of real estate teams, corporations and public sector organizations across the U.S. Our mission is to make buildings better while making it easy for our clients to accelerate their impact.

Job Summary

The Director of Engineering & Development for Distributed Generation
within our Commercial Markets Division
provides strategic leadership and oversight of the project engineering and development function and team. This role establishes departmental priorities and standards across team management, tools and systems, project scope development, engineering execution, budget estimating, scheduling, quality, risk management, and workflow.

Key Components Of This Role Include

Management: Strategic leadership and management of the DG team, including Project Development Engineers; oversight of resource planning, project priorities, workflows, day-to-day operations, training and mentoring, performance, and continuous improvement.
Project Engineering & Development: Direct, facilitate, and/or review site survey [audit] analysis, conceptual project designs, estimating, schedules, product specifications, code research and application, and the preparation of proposal documents.

An effective SitelogIQ Director of Engineering & Development will partner with leaders across Sales, Operations, and Project Management and represent the team and its technical solutions to clients and their technical staff. They will oversee program and project development milestones to deliver timely, comprehensive proposals that clearly communicate project intentions and solutions while meeting SitelogIQ financial and risk metrics. SitelogIQ team members are expected to share knowledge with others by serving as a constant contributor, trainer, mentor, and resource.

Target Salary:
$145,000 - $180,000 dependent on experience.

Director, Engineering & Development Responsibilities

Provide leadership, direction, coaching, and mentorship to the team as they develop and produce DG project designs and proposals.
Oversee the internal proposal queue, resource allocation, team assignments, risk review process, and client commitments.
Facilitate collaboration between the Engineering & Development and Sales teams to determine customers’ specific technical requirements, project scope, definition of work, and product feature needs.
Establish and maintain quality standards for project designs, submittals, and permitting packages.
Lead the development of new processes, tools, and workflows and the continuous improvement of existing practices.
Partner with Sales to define customers’ technical requirements, project scope, definition of work, and product or system feature needs.
Participate in site-surveys, pre-bid and pre-construction meetings as needed; noting that SitelogIQ’s commercial markets team does have an Assessment team devoted to supporting all types of site-surveys including DG projects.
Maintain all internal documentation in a collaborative file sharing and storage environment.
Lead technical strategy and support for large RFP and business development opportunities.
Participate in quality control review of peer project development team
Ensure effective coordination of installation details with Project Managers and Account Executives and support field installation when needed.
Oversee the evaluation of site audits and selection of product solutions that provide clients with the optimal balance of functionality, long-term operating expense, aesthetics, and constructability.
Establish quality control standards and review submittal packages (product data sheets; bill of materials; standard and customer drawings; layout and connection detail drawings; return on investment analysis; etc.) for content accuracy and alignment with proposal goals.
Review and markup drawings for typical product applications
Review and present DG solution proposals
Ensure local jurisdiction code compliance research is completed and incorporated into project solutions.
Partner with construction leaders to establish accurate project cost estimates.
Establish design intent and specifications and ensure the team consistently meets them.
Provide technical leadership for large RFP and business development opportunities, including the creation of detailed submittal packages.
Coordinate installation details with Project Managers and Account Executives. Support field installation when needed
Lead quality control reviews of projects
Any, and all ad hoc reporting, requests or other tasks deemed

Director, Engineering & Development Requirements & Qualifications

Industry experience and credentials required:
At least 10 years of progressive experience in engineering, project development, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience leading, managing, and developing a team.

Active Professional Engineer license in at least one U.S. jurisdiction, with the ability to obtain additional licenses through comity as required.
Experience understanding audit and field survey data and translating that into design documents and drawings.
Experience performing sales liaison and client collaboration in energy or related industries.
Strong understanding of DG systems and corresponding customer requirements.
Excellent understanding of financial business principles.
Adept at project scheduling, task definition and effort estimation.
Demonstrated ability to lead projects from concept through completion.
Strong design evaluation, documentation writing skills, problem solving skills, and attention to detail.
Professional communication and presentation skills.
Must be able to work independently, with minimal supervision under time sensitive deadlines.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office products such as Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, etc.
Experience with file sharing, document management and collaboration tools.

Work Environment And Physical Requirements

This position operates in both office and field settings. While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be regularly required to sit, stand, talk, hear, reach, bend, stoop, kneel, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer, phone, and keyboard. May regularly need to lift up to 20 lbs., unassisted. Travel will be required for site assessments and customer presentations.

Benefits

We offer a highly competitive salary, and comprehensive benefits, including:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Disability and life insurance
401K
Flex time off
12 paid holidays
Tuition reimbursement
Opportunities to drive our DE&I efforts by joining our affinity groups, Veterans and Allies Leadership Organization, or Women Inspiring & Strengthening Everyone
Opportunities to give back to our local communities through organized events or fundraisers

More About SitelogIQ

At SitelogIQ, we’re focused on creating a great environment for our team first so that it is more energizing and rewarding to focus on creating great customer experience. That’s what we call a win-win.

We partner with clients in K-12, higher ed, government, healthcare, multifamily housing, and industry to optimize energy efficiency, improve indoor air quality, address lighting, and improve the customer experience. With offices across the country, it’s rewarding to make a difference in the communities where our teammates live and work.

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may be asked to perform other related duties as required to meet the ongoing needs of the Organization .

SitelogIQ is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in the E-Verify program.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Site Reliability Engineering - Cloud Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About Futurex

Futurex is a Texas-based leader in hardware security modules (HSMs), enterprise key management, and data protection, trusted by global financial institutions, payment processors, and cloud providers for more than four decades. Futurex Cloud Infrastructure delivers secure, highly available services to customers around the world.

Role overview

The Senior Manager, Site Reliability Engineering - Cloud Infrastructure owns the availability, security, and operational excellence of Futurex Cloud Infrastructure worldwide. You will lead a globally distributed SRE team that runs production infrastructure across multiple regions, cloud providers, and datacenters.

This role sits at the intersection of cloud operations, security, and compliance. Our customers depend on services that cannot go down, so reliability here is measured in customer trust as much as uptime.

You will report to executive leadership and partner closely with Engineering, Product, Security, Compliance, and Customer Support.

Key responsibilities

Team leadership

Lead, hire, and develop a global SRE team across multiple time zones, with clear ownership and follow-the-sun coverage
Own the global on-call program, including rotation design, response time standards, escalation paths, and coverage across all regions
Hold the team accountable for incident response, remediation follow-through, and adherence to operational standards
Set the SRE roadmap, staffing plan, and operating budget

Reliability and service levels

Define and own SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets for Cloud Infrastructure services, and use them to balance stability against release velocity
Partner with Sales and Legal so customer SLA commitments are consistently met
Track SLA compliance and error budget consumption across all services

Operational reporting

Deliver regular reporting to executive leadership on uptime, SLA performance, incident trends, and on-call metrics such as response times and escalation volume
Maintain dashboards that give leadership and stakeholders real-time visibility into service health
Produce customer-facing incident reports and root cause analyses for significant events

Incident management

Own the incident response process, including severity definitions, escalation paths, and customer communications
Lead postmortems and drive remediation items to closure
Serve as the senior escalation point during major incidents

Infrastructure and operations

Review monitoring, observability, and alerting standards
Maintain and regularly test disaster recovery and business continuity plans against defined RTO and RPO targets

Security and compliance

Operate within the controls required by industry security and compliance frameworks
Oversee secure operational procedures, including dual control and chain of custody where required
Enforce strict tenant isolation, least-privilege access, and change management
Support internal and external audits with accurate operational evidence

Requirements

Required qualifications

10+ years in SRE, DevOps, or production infrastructure roles, including 5+ years managing engineering teams
Experience leading geographically distributed teams across multiple time zones
Proven ownership of a production SaaS or cloud platform with contractual SLAs and 24x7 operations
Hands-on depth in at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure), with working knowledge of the others
Strong background in Linux, networking, infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar), and CI/CD
Experience operating under compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS, SOC 2, or ISO 27001
A track record of building incident management, observability, and DR programs
Clear written and verbal communication with executives, customers, and auditors
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

Preferred Qualifications

Experience operating security-sensitive or cryptographic infrastructure
Familiarity with security certification standards such as FIPS 140
Experience running hybrid environments that combine public cloud with physical datacenter hardware
Experience leading datacenter migrations or regional expansions
Background in financial services or another highly regulated industry

Benefits

Health, dental, vision, life, and short/long-term disability insurance
Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave
Competitive compensation and opportunities for advancement
Retirement plan with employer contribution match
Welcoming, family-style corporate culture uniquely suited to fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and motivated individuals
One of San Antonio's "Best Places to Work" for nine consecutive years

jobs.title: Senior Manager IT Infrastructure
jobs.description:
We are constantly looking to add to our core talent. If you are seeking a career that is challenging and rewarding, a work environment that is diverse and dynamic, look no further — Haemonetics is your employer of choice.

Job Details

The Senior Manager, Information Technology Infrastructure leads the strategy, delivery, security, reliability, and continuous improvement of the organization’s enterprise infrastructure services. This role manages infrastructure operations across cloud and on-premises environments, including compute, storage, customer-facing hosting platforms, data centers, backup and recovery, and end-user technology services. The Senior Manager partners with business and technology leaders to translate organizational needs into scalable, secure, and cost-effective solutions while developing a high-performing technical team and ensuring operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure strategy: Develop and execute a multi-year infrastructure roadmap aligned with business priorities, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity requirements, and financial objectives.
Service ownership: Ensure the availability, performance, scalability, and supportability of cloud, network, server, storage, identity, collaboration, backup, disaster recovery, and endpoint services.
Operational excellence: Establish service-level objectives, operational metrics, monitoring, incident response, problem management, change management, capacity planning, patching, lifecycle management, and continuous-improvement practices.
Cybersecurity and compliance: Partner with information security, risk, privacy, and compliance teams to implement required controls, remediate vulnerabilities, support audits, and maintain secure configurations.
Cloud and modernization: Lead cloud adoption, automation, standardization, technical-debt reduction, and modernization initiatives while optimizing performance, resilience, and cost.
Business continuity: Maintain tested backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities; define recovery objectives and coordinate exercises and remediation activities.
People leadership: Hire, coach, develop, and retain infrastructure professionals; establish clear objectives, accountability, succession plans, and development opportunities.
Financial and vendor management: Own budgets, forecasts, licensing, asset lifecycle plans, contracts, sourcing activities, and supplier performance; identify opportunities to improve value and reduce total cost of ownership.
Stakeholder partnership: Communicate service health, risks, priorities, and investment needs to technical and nontechnical leaders; collaborate across applications, security, data, facilities, and business functions.
Governance and documentation: Maintain standards, procedures, architecture documentation, support models, inventories, and decision records that enable reliable and repeatable service delivery.
Escalation leadership: Provide executive-level coordination during critical incidents, ensure timely communications, and drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in IT, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Relevant certifications such as ITIL, Microsoft, AWS, Veeam, Linux, PDQ or VMware.
Experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or comparable cloud platforms and hybrid infrastructure.
Experience supporting regulated & controlled environments (life sciences, healthcare).
10 + years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure across cloud and on-premises environments., operations, engineering, or service delivery,
5+ years in a people-management role. Talent development and team leadership
Strong knowledge of networking, compute, storage, virtualization, identity and access management, enterprise collaboration, backup and recovery, monitoring, endpoint management, and infrastructure automation.
Experience leading IT service management and infrastructure operations and complex infrastructure transformations.
Proven ability to manage budgets, forecasts, contracts & external providers.
Strategic thinking and disciplined execution
Customer and business orientation
Sound judgment, ownership, and accountability
Clear communication and stakeholder influence
Risk awareness and continuous improvement
Collaboration across technical and business teams

Additional Requirements

May require participation in an on-call escalation rotation and availability outside normal business hours for critical incidents or planned maintenance.
Periodic travel may be required to company sites, data centers, or supplier locations.
Works in a hybrid office and remote environment, subject to organizational policy and business needs.

Pay Transparency

The pay range for this role is:

$124,300.00-$211,700.00/Annual

The base pay actually offered to the successful candidate will take into account, without limitation, the candidate’s location, education, job-knowledge, skills, and experience in prior relevant roles.

Incentives may also be provided as part of Haemonetics’ employee compensation. For sales roles
, employees will be eligible for sales incentive (i.e., commission) under the applicable plan terms. For non-sales roles
, employees will be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, the target amount of which varies based on the applicable role, to be governed by the applicable plan terms. Robotic system design and integration

Manufacturing, reliability, and production scale-up
Working with multidisciplinary teams across hardware, software, and AI
