new_jobs.title: Director of Data Engineering and Analytics
new_jobs.description:
About Us

Greenbrook Medical is building the new standard in primary care.

We deliver high-touch, relationship-based care through neighborhood clinics, grounded in a simple belief: every senior deserves the kind of care we would want for our own families. Our model prioritizes time with patients, strong care coordination, and a personalized approach that improves outcomes while lowering total cost of care.

We take full accountability for patient outcomes and overall cost of care, aligning clinical excellence with disciplined execution. That commitment shows up in our results, including a patient Net Promoter Score of 90, compared to 32 for typical healthcare organizations.

Rooted in Tampa Bay and partnered with Tampa General Hospital, we are entering an exciting phase of growth. Backed by strong unit economics, experienced operators, and a proven playbook, we are looking for builders and operators who want to help scale a healthcare platform designed to deliver better care, better coordination, and better outcomes for seniors.

About The Role

We're hiring our first dedicated data leader. You'll build Greenbrook's foundational data layer and data intelligence capabilities. You’ll also build our data team and culture from the ground up.

This is a hands on role. You'll be in the code daily, own what's in production from day one, and build the roadmap from scratch, inclusive of data infrastructure and business logic. You will forecast needs out on the magnitude of quarters and build a team to support delivery.

Success in this role means end to end ownership, from data platform to metric delivery and data team performance. You report to the VP of Growth and Population Health and partner closely with our care teams to improve observability on our care model.

As Greenbrook’s Head of Data & Analytics, you own four things:

The analytics layer: the dbt models and business logic that turn raw data into something usable, and the metric definitions underneath them
Reporting and BI: the reporting layer the whole business reads from, and turning data into findings that our teams can react on to improve performance
Our production systems: you take ownership of systems as they come in-house from our engineering partner, harden them, and keep making them better, with accountability for uptime & system integrity
The data roadmap and team development: You will develop, in partnership with Greenbrook’s functional leaders, a data capabilities roadmap that supports the business. You will translate that roadmap into tactical goals and hiring plans to ensure that the data team is improving observability across all aspects of the business.

Location:
New York City strongly preferred (Hybrid). Open to exceptional remote candidates.

What You'll Do

Own the Analytics Layer

Build and maintain the dbt models and business logic behind our metrics and workflows in Google Cloud
Ensure metric definitions are consistent across every surface at Greenbrook
Build the reporting and dashboards the business uses to make decisions

Take Ownership of What's in Production

Take on systems as they move from our engineering partner into steady state, and keep improving them.
Catch ingestion, pipeline, and logic issues, and resolve them within our SLAs. Build monitoring and uptime reporting.
Be the counterpart our engineering partner hands production work to. Resolve what you can and escalate what needs them.

Make the Care Model Better With Data

Calculate and report on industry-standard care model measures
Turn quality and care-gap logic into triggers and flags inside our clinical workflows, so we act on data during the encounter, not after
Sit in the operating meetings where data gets used. Understand the care model well enough to define what we should measure and what good looks like
Surface patterns and risks proactively, acting as an early warning system for the business

Build the roadmap and the team

Own the end-to-end data roadmap, from data strategy to product delivery and integration. Construct roadmaps on the order of quarters that align with what the business needs
Build the data team from scratch. Put together a people roadmap, define sub-competencies based off of our needs, and design levels and competencies
Hire and manage data engineers and analysts. Start as a player coach and then hire to supplement skills and ensure delivery against the roadmap

What Success Looks Like

Data trust: the business trusts the numbers, and you're ahead of issues rather than behind them
Impact: data changes how we deliver care, and our quality measures improve year over year
Early warning: leaders hear about emerging problems from you first
Coverage: every metric our operating levers depend on has a certified definition and a single source of truth
Reliability: systems transitioned to you stay healthy and get fixed fast when they break
Scale readiness: new clinics come online with full data coverage from day one
Delivery: committed quarterly work ships, and your counterparts, including performance managers and the Head of Population Health, rate the partnership highly

About You

You bring:

Strong SQL, dbt, and Python, and you still write production code
Hands-on experience with healthcare data, including claims, eligibility, and EHR data and familiarity with interoperability standards such as FHIR and HL7
Experience with value-based care measurement, such as HEDIS/Stars, HCC/RAF, and utilization
The ability to interpret data and explain what it means to clinical and business leaders in plain language
Experience owning production systems, including being the person who responds when something breaks
Experience building roadmaps, driving alignment on them, and hiring technical talent
A bachelor's degree
A mindset grounded in our core values of Heart, Excellence, Accountability, Resilience, and Teamwork

You'll Stand Out If You

Have done this at a risk-bearing organization, such as an ACO, MA plan, or at-risk provider, especially where data powered internal clinical software
Tie data to workflow: you've moved a quality measure, not just reported on it
Challenge the status quo constructively: you'll tell us what's not working and why
Get to root cause: you find out why a number is wrong instead of patching the symptom
Enjoy both hardening what exists and building what's next
Are AI-native: you use modern AI tools in your daily work
Drive outcomes: you have a bias for action and close loops without being chased

Why You'll Love Working Here

Make An Impact Every Day

Be part of a mission-driven team transforming primary care for seniors. Your work directly supports better outcomes, better coordination, and better experiences for some of the most vulnerable patients in healthcare.

Work That Actually Matters

We're not a volume-driven system, we're accountable for outcomes. That means your work directly contributes to quality care, patient satisfaction, and meaningful improvements in how healthcare is delivered.

Build And Grow With Us

We're building more than a company, we're building careers. As we expand, you'll have opportunities to grow your skills and take on new challenges.

Strong, Transparent Compensation & Benefits

Competitive base salary: Remote (U.S.): $160,000–$190,000; New York City: $175,000–$210,000
Generous annual performance bonus
Health, dental, and vision insurance
Paid time off
401(k) with company match

Our Selection Process

Application → Initial interview → Skills/experience interview → Values interview → Case Study and Case Study Interview → References

Equal Employment Opportunity and Commitment to Diversity

At Greenbrook Medical, we believe the only way we accomplish our mission is by building the best team in healthcare. We do this through a culture of respect and belonging, ensuring our teammates feel cared for first and foremost.

We will extend equal employment opportunity to all applicants without regard to age, race, ethnicity, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, socioeconomic background, disability status, military affiliation, pregnancy or any other status protected under federal, state and local laws. We encourage all who share our mission to apply. Greenbrook Medical will provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process. If you need additional accommodations or assistance, do not hesitate to contact our People team at recruiting@greenbrookmedical.com.

new_jobs.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.

We are hiring a Senior Manager, Software Development Engineer to join our Lodging Connectivity - Partner Developer Experience team. This team designs, builds, and operates Lodging Connectivity services, external APIs, and developer tools that power lodging supply partner integrations, with a strong focus on the partner developer experience. In this role you will be a hands-on technical leader, delivering best-in-class self-service integration capabilities and experiences to external partner developers and supply partners.

In This Role, You Will

Lead multiple software engineering teams that design, build, and operate resilient, scalable Lodging Connectivity services, external APIs, and partner-facing developer tools, while dedicating approximately 50% of your time to hands-on software design, development, and delivery.
Personally design and build software systems, contribute production code, and own individual software delivery outcomes in addition to leading the broader engineering organization.
Safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled and AI‑assisted solutions within connectivity systems to improve partner and traveler outcomes, including familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products.
Define and drive technical direction and system design across key connectivity domains, including high-level and low-level design, API schema design, data modeling, and integration patterns with external lodging partners and internal platforms.
Establish and maintain high engineering standards for code quality, observability, reliability, and security, ensuring services are robust, well-instrumented, and compliant with organizational and industry expectations.
Partner closely with product, business, and operations stakeholders to translate complex lodging connectivity requirements into clear technical roadmaps, balancing delivery speed, quality, and long-term platform health.
Build, develop, and mentor a diverse team of software engineers and engineering managers, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and technical excellence across multiple domains.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent Level; Technical Degree Preferred.
8+ years of relevant professional experience and 3+ years of people management experience.
Substantial professional experience in software engineering, including prior experience managing engineers and owning multi-service or domain-level systems in a production environment.
Proven ownership of complex, distributed services or platforms, including end-to-end responsibility for design, implementation, deployment, and ongoing operations.
Strong technical background in service-oriented or microservices architectures, system design (including LLD), API design, and data modeling, with hands-on familiarity enabling effective technical leadership.
Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, with the ability to guide teams in safely integrating such capabilities into production services.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading engineering organizations that operate large-scale, highly available, and secure connectivity or integration platforms, ideally in travel, e-commerce, or similarly complex domains and with a focus on the partner developer experience.
Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products, including safely integrating and operating AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve developer productivity, service quality, or partner experience.
Track record of driving architectural evolution for multi-service or domain-level systems, including refactoring legacy components, defining integration contracts, and improving performance, reliability, and observability.
Demonstrated excellence in operational leadership, including incident management, on-call practices, capacity planning, and building a culture of data-driven continuous improvement in production environments.
Experience using AI-assisted software development, intelligent testing, code analysis, or operational tooling in hands-on engineering work while maintaining robust governance, security, and compliance.

The total cash range for this position in Austin is $184,500.00 to $258,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $295,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Description

Senior Software Development Manager, FAIM Evaluations.

Amazon Advertising is building toward a future where an advertiser specifies a few marketing parameters (budget, success definition, which products to promote) and a set of AI agents handles the rest. The Full Funnel Agentic Intelligence and Models (FAIM) organization owns that bet: the Ads Nova agent, the Ads Nova model it reasons with, and the agent infrastructure, learning environments, and evaluations that connect the two. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Manager to found and lead the FAIM Evaluations team. You will report directly to the Vice President of Full Funnel Agentic Intelligence and Models and own how the entire organization answers one question: is this actually good at advertising?

This is a ground-up build. Evaluation today lives inside individual model and agent teams, measured task by task. You will create the standalone engineering team that turns it into a shared, rigorous system spanning the Ads Nova model, the Ads Nova agent, and the internal agent that serves our Sales, Services, and Operations teams. No inherited harness, no pattern to follow, and a direct line to the VP who sponsors the work.

What we're building

An advertising benchmark: a representative set of real advertising tasks, organized by domain and difficulty, from single-step questions through multi-step analysis to long-horizon strategic work, each with structured criteria for what a correct end-to-end response looks like

Evaluation infrastructure that scores models and agents deterministically against that benchmark, compares Ads Nova to frontier models on the tasks that matter to advertisers, and gives every science and product team in FAIM the same yardstick

Rubrics and task environments built to serve double duty: scoring quality today and producing the reward signal that trains the next version of the model

An expert-in-the-loop program that captures how experienced advertising practitioners actually work and encodes that judgment into criteria a machine can grade against

A capability map, derived from benchmark results, that tells FAIM where the model and agent stand and what to train next

Key job responsibilities

Found and lead a standalone team of roughly 10-12: software engineers plus a product manager and a technical program manager; you will hire most of them

Own the technical vision and roadmap for FAIM evaluations end to end: task taxonomy, rubric design, environment construction, scoring, benchmark versioning, and the separation between what we evaluate on and what we train on

Build for the whole org, not one product: your team evaluates the Ads Nova model, the Ads Nova agent, and the internal agent, and you participate in the planning and reviews for all three

Partner with applied scientists across FAIM to turn evaluation criteria into training signal for reinforcement learning, and to make sure what we measure is what we optimize

Run the domain-expert program: source advertising practitioners, define the annotation and calibration process, and hold the quality bar on inter-rater agreement

Set the evaluation standard for the organization and hold the line on it; where good internal assets already exist, adopt them rather than rebuild

Publish results leadership and partner teams trust, and own the cadence for re-scoring as models, agents, and tasks evolve

Represent evaluations in VP-level reviews, annual planning, and cross-org discussions on model and agent quality

We're looking for a leader who brings

10+ years of engineering experience and 5+ years managing engineering teams, including building a team from a small core

A track record delivering evaluation systems, benchmarks, or data-quality programs for machine learning models, ideally large language models or agentic systems

Working fluency in how modern models are trained and improved (supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from rubric or verifier signal) and what makes an eval useful as a training asset rather than only a scorecard

Judgment about measurement: when all-or-nothing grading beats partial credit, how to find ambiguous criteria through grader disagreement

Experience running expert-annotation or labeling programs with external partners, including quality control at scale

The ability to operate in ambiguity: turn "is it good at advertising" into a concrete, scored, versioned asset with minimal scoping help

Comfort working as the engineering counterpart to scientists you do not manage, and the influence to get model, agent, and product teams onto one yardstick

Advertising domain knowledge, or the curiosity and speed to build it by working closely with practitioners

Experience with Amazon Bedrock, agent frameworks, and tool-use protocols (MCP) is a plus

10+ years of engineering experience
5+ years of engineering team management experience
10+ years of planning, designing, developing and delivering consumer software experience
Experience partnering with product or program management teams
Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment
10+ years of software development experience
Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or related technical field
Experience designing, building, operating, and managing large-scale distributed systems or web services
Experience with software development in a team, and a track record of shipping software on time

new_jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Prototyping AI and Customer Engineering, AWS Prototyping and AI Customer Engineering (PACE)
new_jobs.description:
Description

AWS Prototyping and AI Customer Engineering (PACE) is the team customers work with when they need to move from idea to production on their most complex AI and cloud challenges. We build working prototypes, run executive briefings, and deliver guided builds that compress months of development into days. Our work directly influences customer commitment decisions spanning generative AI, agentic architectures, computer vision, and full-stack cloud modernization. PACE operates globally with teams aligned to industry verticals in each geo, ensuring deep customer proximity and field stakeholder partnership.

We are looking for a Sr. Manager, Solutions Architecture to lead one of the PACE North America delivery teams, aligned to Financial Services (FSI), Retail & (CPG), and Canada (inclusive of all industries). You will own integrated PODs, each paired with a technical program manager and dedicated prototyping architects, and you will be responsible for the quality, velocity, and business impact of every engagement your team delivers. You will manage approximately 10 to 12 people directly.

You will develop deep relationships with field stakeholders (Sales Directors, Solutions Architecture Leaders, CSM Leaders) across FSI, Retail and CPG, and Canada. You will own the delivery side of those partnerships and drive operational rigor: capacity planning, engagement intake prioritization, prototype quality standards, and the mechanisms that connect prototyping work to launched revenue. You will coach and grow your team across a mix of experience levels, from early-career prototyping architects through senior technical program managers.

The right person for this role has experience building and shipping production-grade AI systems, has led technical teams through ambiguous customer problems, and has the judgment to know when a prototype needs another day of polish and when it needs to ship now. You care about growing people as much as growing the business, and you can context-switch between coaching a newer team member and presenting to a customer CTO in the same afternoon.

Key job responsibilities

Lead, coach, and develop a team of prototyping architects and technical program managers organized in industry-aligned PODs covering FSI, Retail and CPG, and Canada. Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, and promotion readiness for every team member.

Own engagement delivery quality and velocity for your PODs. Set the technical bar for prototypes, executive briefing centers (EBCs), guided builds, and AI Discovery Lifecycle (AI-DLC) workshops. Review architectures and unblock technical decisions across your team's engagements.

Build and maintain deep stakeholder relationships with Sales, SA, and CSM leadership across your industry verticals. Participate in pipeline reviews, strategy sessions, and QBRs. Be the delivery-side counterpart that field leaders call when they need prototyping capacity for a critical account.

Drive operational mechanisms: engagement intake and prioritization, capacity planning and allocation, prototype-to-production tracking, and the reporting that connects delivery to business outcomes. Ensure your PODs are staffed to meet demand without burning out individuals.

Maintain technical currency with GenAI and cloud architecture to sustain credibility with your team and with field stakeholders, particularly in agentic AI (AgentCore, Bedrock Agents), foundation model deployment (SageMaker, EKS), and multi-agent systems.

Partner with peer managers and the PACE North America Leader to balance capacity across verticals during demand spikes, share prototyping assets and patterns across PODs, and maintain a unified quality bar for the organization.

Identify patterns across customer engagements in your verticals and codify them into reusable assets (reference architectures, starter kits, workshop frameworks) that accelerate future delivery and feed the PACE Scale motion.

About The Team

ACE operates at the frontier of what customers are building on AWS. We are the team that takes the hardest "can we actually do this?" questions from the field and turns them into working systems, often in days. Our prototypes have influenced customer commitments across every major industry, displaced competitors in active evaluations, and produced reusable assets now adopted across AWS. We work across every major AI paradigm (generative AI, computer vision, NLP, physical AI, agentic systems) and every major industry vertical in North America.

We are a small, high-output team. That means every person matters, every engagement matters, and the manager closest to the work has real influence on business outcomes. If you want a leadership role where your decisions directly move the needle, this is it.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
7+ years of management of technical, enterprise customer facing resources or equivalent experience
Knowledge of software development tools and methodologies
Demonstrated ability to build relationships with senior technical and business stakeholders (VP/C-level) and translate their business problems into technical solutions.
Experience working directly with enterprise customers on complex technical engagements, including architecture design, proof-of-concept development, and production deployment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with generative AI technologies, including foundation models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic architectures, and multi-agent systems.
Familiarity with AWS AI/ML services (Bedrock, AgentCore, SageMaker, Q) and cloud-native architectures.
Track record of building and scaling prototyping or rapid delivery teams that operate at the intersection of sales engineering and product development.
Experience managing geographically distributed teams across multiple time zones, including cross-border teams.

new_jobs.title: Director, Infrastructure & IT Operations
new_jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

The hiring organization is seeking a strategic and hands-on Director, Infrastructure & IT Operations
to lead the technology capabilities that keep digital products, cloud platforms, and internal teams secure, reliable, and productive.

This role oversees cloud infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), production operations, bot mitigation, corporate IT, and helpdesk support, while providing architectural leadership across cloud platforms, networking, identity, observability, and operational tooling. This position spans both internal employee technology and the production infrastructure supporting high-traffic, customer-facing applications.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Lead teams responsible for cloud infrastructure, SRE, production operations, corporate IT, helpdesk, and bot mitigation, establishing ownership, operational standards, service-level objectives (SLOs), escalation procedures, and performance metrics.
Develop managers, technical leads, and IT staff through coaching, career development, and building a culture of accountability, documentation, automation, and continuous improvement.
Build quarterly and annual infrastructure roadmaps aligned with business priorities, growth, security, reliability, and cost, partnering with engineering, product, data, marketing, finance, HR, legal, and executive leadership.
Own the reliability, scalability, security, performance, and cost-effectiveness of cloud infrastructure, primarily within AWS.
Provide architectural leadership across cloud services, applications, APIs, networking, identity, databases, storage, observability, and integrations while establishing architecture standards, reference patterns, governance, and technical review processes.
Partner with engineering to improve deployment safety, performance, and readiness, driving automation, configuration management, and infrastructure as code.
Lead capacity planning for growth and demand spikes, eliminating single points of failure, undocumented systems, manual processes, and single-source dependencies.
Ensure production and nonproduction environments are properly separated, secured, and monitored, reviewing new systems for architectural fit, supportability, security, and total cost of ownership.
Establish and maintain service-level indicators (SLIs), SLOs, availability targets, and error-budget practices for critical systems.
Improve observability through centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, application performance monitoring (APM), and actionable alerting.
Lead major incident management, coordination, executive communication, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action tracking to improve mean time to detect, respond, and recover.
Develop and test backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures, and establish sustainable on-call practices.
Own strategy and tooling for bot mitigation, scraping protection, automated abuse prevention, and traffic-quality management using technologies such as Cloudflare, DataDome, web application firewalls (WAFs), rate limiting, CAPTCHA alternatives, and device fingerprinting.
Partner with cross-functional teams to distinguish malicious automation from legitimate customers, search engines, partners, and approved AI crawlers, establishing monitoring and response procedures.
Oversee internal IT services and helpdesk support, establishing service-level expectations for response times, resolution times, user satisfaction, and backlog reduction.
Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, equipment provisioning, access management, asset recovery, and device inventory.
Standardize endpoint configuration, encryption, patching, and endpoint detection across laptops, collaboration platforms, productivity software, and telecom services.
Establish consistent identity and access management practices across corporate and production systems, implementing role-based access, least privilege, multi-factor authentication (MFA), periodic access reviews, and secure administrative account handling.
Support vulnerability remediation, security assessments, audits, vendor reviews, incident readiness, and applicable privacy requirements in partnership with legal and security teams.
Manage infrastructure, security, IT, telecom, monitoring, and support vendors, handling evaluations, contract reviews, renewals, licensing, service level agreements (SLAs), and budget management.
Improve cloud cost visibility through tagging, allocation, forecasting, tool consolidation, and contract optimization.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, SRE, platform engineering, DevOps, IT operations, or related disciplines.
5+ years of experience leading engineering or technology teams, including managing managers or technical leads.
Demonstrated experience operating high-traffic, customer-facing platforms in AWS or a comparable cloud environment.
Strong understanding of cloud architecture, networking, identity, security, observability, databases, APIs, storage, and distributed systems.
Experience managing production availability, incident response, root-cause analysis, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Experience with infrastructure automation, configuration management, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
Experience managing corporate IT, employee support, endpoint management, software licensing, and access provisioning.
Experience establishing operational metrics, SLOs, and support standards.
Demonstrated ability to manage vendors, contracts, departmental budgets, and cloud costs.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks, architecture, and tradeoffs to executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Cloudflare, DataDome, or comparable bot-management and web application protection platforms, including leading bot mitigation or traffic-quality programs.
Experience with AWS services, containerized environments, infrastructure as code, centralized logging, and APM tools (such as AppDynamics).
Experience supporting large-scale consumer subscription, public-record, data-as-a-service, advertising, or ecommerce platforms.
Experience modernizing legacy infrastructure, transitioning systems from external vendors, and consolidating cloud accounts or IT services.
Familiarity with privacy requirements and secure handling of sensitive consumer data.
Experience building or maturing SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering functions.

Measures of Success

Improved availability, performance, and stability of customer-facing platforms.
Reduced impact and infrastructure costs associated with bots, scraping, and automated abuse.
Faster incident detection, response, and recovery, alongside a reduction in recurring incidents.
Enhanced observability with reduced alert noise, validated disaster recovery capabilities, and optimized cloud spend.
Consistent helpdesk performance, reliable onboarding and offboarding, and robust endpoint security and asset tracking.
Strong architecture governance, reduced dependency on undocumented systems or vendors, and demonstrated team development.

Compensation and Benefits

Annual base salary: $170,000 - $180,000

Comprehensive health coverage including medical, dental, and vision insurance
Life insurance
Retirement benefits with employer match

About Zuora

At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.

We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Director of Engineering to lead the teams building and operating our payments platform. You'll shape technical strategy, strengthen engineering execution, and develop an organization that delivers reliable, scalable payment experiences.

This role requires a leader who combines technical depth with strong organizational leadership: someone who raises the bar for system performance, software quality, and operational discipline while helping teams move faster through effective use of AI tooling. Payment experience is a plus.

In This Role, You'll

Lead for performance, scale, and resilience. Define the architecture and technical roadmap for a payments platform that supports growing transaction volumes, delivers low latency, and remains reliable through traffic spikes and downstream failures.
Raise engineering and operational standards. Establish strong practices for system design, code quality, testing, observability, incident response, and continuous improvement. Build consistent approaches to integrating and operating across multiple payment gateways, including failure isolation, safe retries, and recovery.
Improve engineering productivity with AI. Accelerate the adoption of AI tools across development, testing, code review, and troubleshooting. Measure their impact on delivery speed and quality, and establish practices that preserve security and maintainability.
Partner across the business. Work closely with Product, Cloud Engineering, Security and gateway partners to deliver the business outcomes.

About You

You bring:

Experience leading multiple engineering teams and managers, with responsibility for technical strategy, organizational health, and execution.
A track record of building and operating high-throughput, highly available distributed systems, with demonstrated improvements in performance, scalability, and resilience.
Strong technical judgment and the ability to engage deeply in architecture, design, and code quality while empowering teams to make decisions.
Experience establishing engineering and operational excellence across complex systems and third-party integrations, including clear service objectives, effective incident management, and measurable reliability improvements.
Practical experience improving engineering productivity through AI tooling with an emphasis on measurable outcomes.
Demonstrated success recruiting, retaining, and developing engineers and managers, setting ambitious but achievable goals, and addressing performance gaps directly and constructively.
Strong communication and cross-functional leadership skills, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs and connect engineering decisions to business priorities.

Preferred Experience

Payments experience spanning gateways, processors, orchestration, authorization, settlement, reconciliation, or payment risk.
Familiarity with financial transaction correctness, idempotency, payment security, and PCI compliance.

Deep payments expertise is welcome, but not required. We value leaders who have built reliable systems, developed strong teams, and can learn a complex domain quickly.

About The Team

You'll lead multiple engineering teams and managers responsible for the full lifecycle of our payments platform—from system architecture and gateway integration to operational reliability and continuous improvement. The organization combines deep technical expertise with strong execution discipline. Success in this role means building leadership capacity across the team, translating business priorities into measurable engineering outcomes, and establishing clear ownership and accountability for delivery, quality, and reliability. You'll work in close partnership with Product, Cloud Engineering, and Security to ensure the platform meets business needs while maintaining the highest standards for performance, availability, and security.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Director of Network Infrastructure and Planning
new_jobs.description:
At Alaska Communications, we’re committed to putting our team first
, always being customer focused
, having a can-do attitude
, owning our results
and always acting with integrity
. This is what we hire for and what our team members exhibit each day. Want to make an impact with us?

We are unable to support remote international applicants or routinely sponsor work visas.

The Compensation Range For This Job Is

$161,475.00 - $215,299.00

Position Summary

Directs and manages the teams and programs responsible for planning, engineering, design, records accuracy, and lifecycle stewardship of network infrastructure supporting the ACS network. This role has complete ownership and accountability for Layer 1 infrastructure planning and design, including outside plant facilities, inside plant infrastructure associated with the network, fiber routes, ducts, conduits, structures, DC power capacity, rack location and availability, capacity, records, and related construction engineering. The role is also accountable for coordinating end-to-end network infrastructure plans across Layer 2 and Layer 3 domains, in partnership with the Sr. Director of IP Engineering and the Network Architects, to ensure physical infrastructure, transport, aggregation, routing, resiliency, and growth plans are aligned to business, customer, operational, and capital priorities.

The Senior Director, Network Infrastructure & Planning translates business demand, network strategy, service delivery requirements, reliability objectives, and funded project commitments into actionable infrastructure plans, budget inputs, engineering priorities, and implementation readiness. The position emphasizes accountable ownership of Layer 1 outcomes while providing shared planning accountability for Layer 2 and Layer 3 network evolution.

Essential Functions

Essential Functions Statement(s)

Owns end-to-end planning and design accountability for Layer 1 network infrastructure, including OSP fiber, copper where applicable, ducts, conduits, poles, handholes, manholes, facility routes, splice plans, capacity, and physical network records.
Owns planning and availability accountability for inside plant infrastructure associated with the network, including DC power capacity, rack location, rack availability, physical space readiness, and related facility dependencies needed to support network growth, resiliency, and implementation readiness.
Ensure Layer 1 infrastructure plans support network reliability, route diversity, resiliency, serviceability, maintainability, constructability, permitting readiness, and economic utilization of facilities.
Oversees analysis of available and existing facilities, route constraints, capacity exhaust, customer demand, traffic growth indicators, and funded project requirements to determine new construction, rearrangements, removals, or augmentation needs.
Develops, maintains, and improves sustainable facilities records processes with the goal of complete, accurate, timely, and electronically accessible network records.
Provides shared accountability for Layer 2 and Layer 3 network planning with the Sr. Director of IP Engineering and network architects, ensuring Layer 1 infrastructure plans are coordinated with transport, aggregation, routing, peering, resiliency, and capacity strategies.
Partners with IP Engineering leadership and architects to translate strategic network architecture into practical infrastructure needs, including site readiness, fiber availability, route diversity, physical path constraints, equipment location requirements, and capital planning inputs.
Facilitates decision-making and escalation when Layer 1 infrastructure constraints affect Layer 2 or Layer 3 design alternatives, schedule, budget, resiliency, or service delivery commitments.
Develops budgetary inputs, capital forecasts, and business case support for approved and proposed network infrastructure projects.

Position Qualifications

Competency Statement(s)

Leadership – Ability to influence others to perform their jobs effectively and to be responsible for making decisions.
Accountability - Ability to plan, organize, measure, and coordinate multiple tasks to deliver the budget for product line, revenue, and profit.
Adaptability - Ability to adapt to change in the workplace.
Analytical Skills - Ability to use thinking and reasoning to solve a problem.
Creative - Ability to think in such a way as to produce a new concept or idea.
Detail Oriented - Ability to pay attention to the minute details of a project or task.
Judgment - The ability to formulate a sound decision using the available information.
Problem Solving - Ability to find a solution for or to deal proactively with work-related problems.
Responsible - Ability to be held accountable or answerable for one’s conduct.
Technical Aptitude - Ability to comprehend complex technical topics and specialized information.
Time Management - Ability to utilize the available time to organize and complete work within given deadlines.

Skills & Abilities

Education:
Bachelor’s Degree in related fields, such as Engineering, Business or Construction. Equivalent experience may be substituted for schooling on a year-for-year basis.

Experience:
Twelve (12) years of telecommunications engineering/construction experience. Equivalent education may be substituted for years of experience.

Computer Skills:
Demonstrated proficiency using Microsoft Office Suite, to include Word, Excel, Outlook, and Access. Demonstrated proficiency using OSP Insight and AutoCAD.

We hope you’ll join us as we change lives through technology.

new_jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, OLO
new_jobs.description:
About Owner

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.

Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.

Our vision

We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.

Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

Our traction

Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website.

More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.

Our team

Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.

We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.

Where we work

Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!

Role Overview

Owner's promise to a restaurant isn't software, it's revenue. When a guest lands on a restaurant's site, we want them to find what they're craving, trust what they see, and check out without friction, whether or not the owner ever touches a setting.

As we scale, we're expanding our product engineering leadership to ship faster, raise the bar on the guest ordering experience, and build the systems that make it work across thousands of restaurants. As the Engineering Manager for OLO, you'll lead a team of full-stack engineers building the guest web ordering experience, from menu, cart and checkout to promotions, photos, and the menu quality systems that make about 10,000 merchant-written menus convert like they were designed by a pro. Next, we're taking OLO to enterprise and multi-location brands, and pushing guest conversion toward 10% through disciplined experimentation. This role is equal parts product intuition and technical execution. You'll be trusted to make hard prioritization calls, ship experiments that move revenue, and grow a team that embodies engineering excellence.

We move with urgency, bias toward simplicity, and expect our leaders to be hands-on when needed. If you're energized by ownership, measurable impact, and solving real problems for small business owners, we'd love to hear from you.

Why we’re looking for you

Owner's promise to a restaurant isn't software — it's revenue. OLO is where that promise gets converted: the guest web ordering experience (menu, cart, checkout, promotions) plus the automated systems that find and fix menu quality problems across roughly 10,000 menus written by merchants we don't control.

We treat conversion as an automated system, not a design review. We build rubrics, detection, and remediation, then prove every change with an experiment. Next, we're taking OLO upmarket to enterprise and multi-location brands and pushing conversion toward 10%.

We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the team through that, keep it healthy, and hold a high bar on what we ship and what we cut.

This role is 100% remote and can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada.

Our Stack

Web / Growth: React, Next.js, TypeScript — guest web ordering, menu quality, experimentation platform
Backend & Services: Node.js, MongoDB → PostgreSQL (migration in flight), Temporal, Datadog
Language: TypeScript everywhere

The Impact You'll Have

Build the experimentation engine that pushes guest conversion toward 10%, across checkout, fulfillment, merchandising, and promotions
Take OLO to enterprise and multi-location brands, with the reliability and menu complexity they need
Get >90% of menus, including POS-integrated ones, to our menu quality bar, and build the system that keeps live menus optimized as they change
Scale photo coverage using guest sourcing, auto-replating, licensed catalogs, and generated combo images, each tied to measured GPV lift
Rebuild promotions from the ground up: redemption UX, badges, auto-apply, and merchandising
Cut fulfillment selection errors and finish the Postgres migration

What We’re Looking For

3+ years of engineering management, leading teams of 6–10+ engineers on customer-facing product
Track record of running growth or conversion programs: metrics, A/B testing at scale, funnel analysis
Experience scaling a product for enterprise or multi-location customers
Strong prioritization: you can take a roadmap bigger than your team and make hard, clear calls
Technical credibility in full-stack web (React/TypeScript, Node.js) and data-heavy systems
Cares about team health and has led people through heavy or repetitive workloads
Excellent cross-functional partner to PM, design, and adjacent teams

Compensation And Benefits

The estimated base salary range for this role is $250K-$270K, depending on experience and location. The offer also includes a a generous pre-IPO equity package.
Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, remote-first workplace, unlimited PTO - plus extra fun perks!

Notice - Employment Scams

Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address.

We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by a scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond.

About the Opportunity

The hiring organization is seeking a Director, IT Operations for a full-time role based in the United States. This leader will oversee global infrastructure, IT service delivery, security and compliance operations, and AI-driven operational initiatives within a healthcare SaaS environment.

Responsibilities

Lead a team of 10+ global resources responsible for help desk services, facility management, SOC policy enforcement, and asset management.
Design and oversee infrastructure architecture to support 99.5%+ uptime across a healthcare SaaS environment.
Deliver help desk services that maintain a 95% SLA within established response and resolution frameworks.
Co-own incident management, escalation protocols, and post-incident review practices.
Manage infrastructure spend and cloud resource optimization across AWS, GCP, or multi-cloud environments.
Drive technical standardization across development, security, and product teams.
Identify, evaluate, and implement AI/ML tools for operational efficiency, including predictive alerting, anomaly detection, root-cause analysis, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experiment with AI-driven automation for routine operational tasks and cultivate a culture of predictive observability.
Partner with the organization's AI Program to explore IT operations transformation and operationalize AI initiatives.
Collaborate with the VP of Enterprise Technology to define operational requirements, observability, and alerting standards for AI model deployment, monitoring, and governance at scale.
Develop operational runbooks and playbooks that support safe, rapid experimentation.
Partner with Security to ensure operational practices align with SOC 2, HIPAA, and state healthcare compliance requirements.
Manage access control, secrets management, least-privilege architectures, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.
Direct quarterly compliance audits and remediation workflows.
Establish and govern SLAs and SLOs for critical services, lead capacity planning, and direct the infrastructure roadmap.
Foster an operational culture grounded in blameless postmortems and continuous improvement.
Communicate infrastructure health, operational risks, and roadmap priorities to leadership and cross-functional teams.
Support product and engineering teams with infrastructure provisioning and technical troubleshooting.
Manage vendor and cloud provider relationships while mentoring and developing operational staff.

Required Qualifications

8+ years of experience in IT operations, infrastructure engineering, or site reliability engineering roles.
5+ years of experience in a leadership role managing technical teams, including at least 5 direct reports.
Demonstrated experience operating mission-critical SaaS or healthcare platforms.
Deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and infrastructure-as-code practices.
Strong understanding of HIPAA compliance, security baselines, and healthcare regulations.
Proven track record of designing systems for 99.5%+ uptime and managing production incidents.
Experience establishing operational cultures focused on automation, blameless postmortems, and on-call excellence.
Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity and establish operational processes from scratch within a fast-growing organization.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building and scaling IT organizations within early-stage or hypergrowth companies.
Hands-on experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, along with modern DevOps toolchains.
Professional background in healthcare environments, including EMR/EHR systems or telehealth platforms.
Experience supporting machine learning or AI infrastructure at scale.
Familiarity with database operations, replication strategies, and backup and recovery management.
Knowledge of healthcare data architecture and data privacy requirements.
Prior experience in startup environments or professional consulting.
Experience evaluating or implementing AI/ML operational tooling, such as predictive alerting or AIOps platforms.
Proven track record of applying AI to enhance operational efficiency or organizational decision-making.

Benefits

Flexible spending and health savings accounts

Life insurance

new_jobs.title: Senior Director, ATE Test Development
new_jobs.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a senior engineering leader to define and scale our ATE development strategy for complex silicon products from new product introduction through high-volume manufacturing. This role leads a global organization responsible for production test architecture, hardware and program development, silicon correlation, quality screening, yield enablement, cost-of-test optimization, and test automation. The ideal candidate brings deep semiconductor test expertise, strong interpersonal leadership, and can drive execution across developing, product engineering, manufacturing, reliability, and supplier ecosystems.

What You Will Be Doing

Set the vision, roadmap, and operating model guiding ATE creation throughout new product introductions and sustaining production.
Lead and develop a distributed team composed of managers and senior engineers covering test hardware, program development, characterization, correlation, productization, and data-driven test optimization.
Drive production test readiness for complex devices, including test coverage, guardband strategy, yield learning, defect screening, quality containment, and test cost reduction.
Establish scalable methodologies, standards, release criteria, and quality gates for ATE development and deployment.
Partner closely with architecture, circuit build, test integration, product engineering, system test, reliability, silicon operations, manufacturing, and collaborators outside the company to ensure strong design-to-test alignment.
Lead the strategy for ATE platform selection, vendor engagement, capacity readiness, and capital planning needed to support product ramps.
Use data and analytics to improve silicon correlation, test limits, binning strategies, excursion response, and long-term product quality.
Build a high-performance leadership culture through strong hiring, interpersonal development, succession planning, and multi-functional influence.

What We Need To See

BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
18+ years of relevant semiconductor experience, including 8 + years of management experience. Leading managers and distributed engineering organizations.
Deep expertise in ATE development for high-volume silicon, SoC, ASIC, or GPU-class products.
Shown success leading organizations through NPI, silicon bring-up, characterization, production ramp, yield improvement, and quality execution.
Strong understanding of ATE platforms, test hardware design, test program development, instrumentation, silicon correlation, statistical analysis, and production test methodologies.
Consistent track record to partner across design, DFT, product engineering, failure analysis, reliability, manufacturing, and supplier or OSAT ecosystems.
Experience owning roadmaps, budgets, staffing plans, and operational priorities for large-scale engineering organizations.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to influence senior collaborators and drive alignment across technical and business teams.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Experience with GPU, AI, networking, or other high-performance compute products.
Track record of reducing test cost while improving outgoing quality and production scalability.
Strong background in test automation, data infrastructure, and improvement guided by data insights.
Experience building and scaling global test-development organizations across multiple sites and external partners.
Familiarity with system-level test, product binning, performance and power optimization, or silicon operations workflows.

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. This role presents an opportunity to have a wide impact at NVIDIA by improving the factory planning function. Are you creative, hard-working, dedicated, and determined? Do you love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 320,000 USD - 483,000 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 11, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.
